title: Discovery call with Lumen Health
notes: Selling Acme Analytics (product analytics). Prospect: Dev, Head of Product at Lumen Health, about 8 people on the product team. Pricing: Team plan 499 USD per month for up to 10 seats, billed annually; Enterprise is custom above 10 seats. Annual prepay gets 2 months free. Integrations: native Snowflake and BigQuery connectors (reads in place, no data copy), Segment source. Security: SOC 2 Type II, SSO on Enterprise only, data stays in the customer's warehouse. 14-day free trial with onboarding call. Goal: book a technical demo with their data team this week.
profile: Alex, account executive at Acme Analytics for 2 years. Previously customer success at a BI startup.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Hey, sorry I'm a couple of minutes late, my last meeting ran over.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: No worries at all. How's your week going?

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Busy, but good. We just closed our quarter, so things are a bit calmer now.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Congrats. So I'd love to understand what made you take this call.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Sure. Right now our product team pulls numbers out of Snowflake by hand, and it takes days to answer basic questions about retention.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: That's a really common pain. Retention questions shouldn't take days.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: So how much would this cost for a team of about eight people?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: For eight people you'd be on our team plan, which is four ninety nine a month.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Hmm. Honestly, that's more than we were hoping to spend right now.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: I understand. Let me explain how teams usually think about it.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Okay. Do you connect to Snowflake directly, or would we need to move our data somewhere?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: We connect directly, so nothing gets copied.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Good. And are you SOC 2 compliant? Our security team will definitely ask.
